recommended_change: Implement full top-level integration in mv_npu_top: instantiate mv_ctrl_fsm/mv_vec_buffer/mv_mac16_core/mv_postproc/mv_stream_if; generate all channel ready signals from FSM state and downstream readiness; generate xfer pulses strictly as ready&&valid; decode/store command via cmd_accept; route vector writes into buffer with proper address counter from FSM progress; unpack matrix beat to lanes and pair with vector lane chunk reads; drive compute/new_row sequencing and lane_valid_mask usage; connect row result into postproc with bias handshake and out backpressure support; expose status_busy/status_error from control. Ensure command ready is asserted in IDLE when able to accept a new job, and deasserted during active job per single-outstanding-job assumption.
do_not_change: Do not alter module interfaces or parameter contracts.
Do not modify frozen tests/reference behavior.
Do not change arithmetic semantics (INT8 signed multiply, INT32 wrap, optional bias/ReLU).
Do not change single-job ordering/backpressure protocol requirements.
expected_side_effects: Once integrated, failures may progress from handshake timeout to functional mismatches in compute/control sequencing if any submodule assumptions are inconsistent.
Ready/valid timing behavior becomes observable on all channels; regression may expose secondary protocol bugs.
